title: The Solo Founder Playbook
description: Stop trading your hours for dollars. Learn how solo software engineers and digital creators build resilient, automated 7-figure businesses using modern code and media leverage. Written by an engineer for builders who value autonomy over vanity metrics.
bullet_points: Why traditional employee scaling introduces coordination drag that slows you down
The 4 types of leverage (Labor, Capital, Code, Content) and how to stack them
The Pain-to-Effort matrix for picking high-margin digital products
How to run a pre-sale campaign that proves real financial demand before coding
Automating your customer acquisition and delivery funnels with zero manual work

social_posts.content:
Why do 90% of solo founders burn out?

They build products that require linear manual support instead of leveraging code and media.

In 'The Solo Founder Playbook', I break down how to build a zero-employee micro-enterprise that scales without stress.

Grab your copy today: https://gumroad.com/l/solo-founder

Most startup advice was written for founders raising venture capital to hire 50 people.

If you want to stay a single operator, you need a different playbook: one built on permissionless leverage, automated inbound funnels, and high-margin product design.

I just published 'The Solo Founder Playbook' — available on Amazon Kindle and PDF: https://amzn.to/solo-founder
